Relax with the whole family at this peaceful house near Höfn. Drink coffee in the magical garden or enjoy a nice dinner in the sunroom. This beautiful homey house is a sanctuary while you enjoy the wonders of Hornafjörður. 

We call it Fagranes or Beauty point and the garden is a true beauty. We encourage our guests to explore the garden, smell the flowers and and find the berries when in season. The garden is beautiful during every season. 

Our house is perfect for families.

The space
A big kitchen with seating for four people, next to the kitchen is the dining room area with seating for six. The living room has a comfy sofa and chairs. The tv area has seating for 4 people and a new TV. The sleeping corridor has three bedroom, the smallest bedroom has two single beds (90x200), the second bedroom has three single beds (90x200) and the master bedroom has king size bed (180x200). The sunroom has a table and seating for four as well as lounge chairs. On the veranda you will find a table and chairs. A charming house with most if its original interiors.

Guest access
Guest can access all part of the property except the garage.

Stayed with kids
Our stay here was perfect. Very kid-friendly (we had a 14-month child with us). The yard is peaceful and fun to explore with kids. The view from to the East was spectacular and made doing dishes or folding laundry a joyful experience. The sun room was an unexpected treat and we spent a lot of time out there. We would highly recommend staying here, especially if you are traveling with children.

Hi there! My name is Sóley and I was born and raised in a country side right outside of Höfn, in the south east of Iceland. I love being out in nature, taking pictures and playing with my dogs Sesar and Atlas Me and my boyfriend, Hjörvar live on a farm with 16 sheep in total - 14 ewes and 2 rams. We bought our guesthouse in 2022 and every day we are trying to make it even better than it is. Looking forward to hosting you!
